title: Ingliz tili: A1–A2 grammatika va lug‘at

questions.q: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
questions.e: "Look!" — hozir bo‘layotgan ish: Present Continuous (are playing).
"Can" o‘zgarmaydi va undan keyin fe’l "to" siz keladi: She can swim.

questions.q: There ___ a cat under the table.
questions.e: Birlik bilan: There is a cat.

questions.q: My sister ___ to school by bus every day.
questions.e: Present Simple, she bilan: go → goes.
You bilan so‘roq: What time do you...?
Unli tovush bilan boshlangan so‘z oldidan "an": an apple.
Qisqa sifatda qiyoslash: young → younger than.
Kitchen — oshxona. Bedroom — yotoqxona, bathroom — hammom.

topics: Present Simple va Continuous, Past Simple, predloglar (in, on, at), can, ko‘plik, egalik ('s), qiyoslash, a/an, kundalik so‘zlar
